name: agent-terminal
description: A Windows terminal that can be securely controlled from a paired mobile device.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentterminal/protocol && npm run build -w @agentterminal/desktop && npm run build -w @agentterminal/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @agentterminal/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @agentterminal/protocol && npm run test:provisioning && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.desktop:portable: npm run build -w @agentterminal/protocol && npm run package:win -w @agentterminal/desktop
